verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a desktop operating system, but the evidence pack never documents one in Ubuntu Desktop. The pack only says Ubuntu is a platform for running third-party AI/ML software. Unity's HUD type-to-find menu search is an adjacent feature, not task delegation to an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
